title: How to Build an Admin Panel Without Code: Complete Guide (2026)
summary: Build a custom admin dashboard with user management, RBAC, and data tables. No Retool subscription needed. Includes step-by-step guide with Blink.
body_markdown: Retool costs $10–$50 per user per month and is internal-tools-only. Five users can cost $250/month. Blink includes the database, auth, and hosting in one plan — no per-seat pricing, and the app can be customer-facing if needed. Retool requires connecting your own database and auth provider. With Blink, those are handled automatically. The trade-off: Retool has more pre-built integrations for enterprise data sources like Salesforce and Snowflake. If you're managing custom application data, Blink ships faster and costs less.
